item.title: Null Awareness Axis — tail, blind zone, 3rd eye, and why only humans scratch their own back
item.dc:creator: Kevin Mok / ecoPrimal / gAIa Institute
item.description: Every animal has a tail except Vitruvian man. The chipmunk paints its tail from memory — it can't see behind itself. The NULL AXIS runs from tail → body center → 3rd eye → nose. Back half = blind zone, front half = aware. Only humans can scratch their own back AND others' — glenohumeral shoulder joint + reciprocal altruism. The 3rd eye (pineal) sits at the blind→aware transition point on the axis. The back IS the blind zone. To see it you need a mirror or a friend.
